protocols.title: B7-33 (10 mg) Dosage Protocol — source reference
protocols.purpose: Individual-page schedule and handling details, transcribed as a research/educational reference
protocols.evidenceNotes: Individual-page statements from a secondary source; not independently verified medical guidance. No established human dose; the page does not supply one. Published findings are cell/rodent-only and no human trial or human PK study exists. A 10 mg vial + 2 mL bacteriostatic water (5 mg/mL) is a reconstitution/concentration reference only; the page notes a roughly six-minute in-vitro serum half-life, so no periodic injection schedule is established.
